summary: Analyzes the impact of bilateral HDB-OB cholinergic inactivation on olfactory discrimination learning and evaluates signal reversibility post-CNO washout.
use_when: Does chemogenetic inactivation of HDB-OB neurons impair olfactory learning?
Assess reversibility of CNO inhibition on olfactory discrimination task performance
Analyze behavioral learning curves for HDB-OB chemogenetic studies
How does CNO-induced inactivation of OB-projecting neurons affect task performance?
Evaluate experimental evidence for recovery after cholinergic inhibition in the olfactory bulb
avoid_when: Independent biological replicates or an appropriate null model are unavailable
